{{Top}}
'''Bofa fruit''' was a sweet [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], which when dried was considered a delicacy in the period of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="The Horse's Mouth">{{InsiderCite|23|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth}}</ref> Later, bofa fruit was used to make a sauce that was served over [[hibbas]] breast.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
